name: model-guard
description: Choose the model each subagent runs on, by rule. Does nothing until you configure it.

default.title: Default model
default.description: Model for a subagent whose call names none (no model, or inherit): an alias such as sonnet, a full model id, or inherit for the main model. Empty leaves it to Claude Code.

rules.title: Rules (JSON)
rules.description: JSON array of {"match": "<regex>", "model": "<alias or id>"}, checked in order against the model a call names. The first match decides; no match leaves the call alone. Example: [{"match": "haiku", "model": "sonnet"}]

forks.title: Forks
forks.description: A fork always runs on the main model. passthrough lets it start; deny refuses it so the caller starts a regular subagent instead.
